recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the previously partial application, fixes the remaining mappings-page target, and keeps generated conformance mapping declarations aligned with the accepted SNOMED shortlink.
issue_request: FHIR-17705 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for FHIR-core-mappings. It reported broken or unhelpful SNOMED CT Concept Domain Binding and SNOMED CT Attribute Binding links on mappings.html and requested the shortlinks http://snomed.org/conceptdomainbinding and http://snomed.org/attributebinding.
initial_application: Historical commit 922dc896f3 (GF#17705 - fix SNomed Links) partially applied the issue: it changed the attribute binding URL to http://snomed.org/attributebinding, but left the concept-domain formal URL and link at http://snomed.info/conceptdomain.
additional_context: The linked 2018 Zulip #snomed thread confirms the same two dead mappings.html SNOMED binding links, and the implementers thread records that the existing links were defaulting to a logical namespace and were not final. source/mappingSpaces.xml is the mappings-page mapping-space input; source/fhir.ini lists Condition and Observation as active resources, and their active StructureDefinition/profile sources still declared the stale sct-concept mapping URI.
reconciliation: Changed source/mappingSpaces.xml so SNOMED CT Concept Domain Binding uses http://snomed.org/conceptdomainbinding for both url and link, and updated the matching sct-concept mapping URI in active Condition and Observation StructureDefinition/profile sources. The already-correct attribute binding shortlink was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/mappingSpaces.xml: changed the SNOMED CT Concept Domain Binding url/link from http://snomed.info/conceptdomain to http://snomed.org/conceptdomainbinding.
source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml: updated the sct-concept mapping uri to http://snomed.org/conceptdomainbinding.
source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml and Observation vital-sign profile StructureDefinitions: updated the sct-concept mapping uri to http://snomed.org/conceptdomainbinding.
